column5: aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṁ saṁskārārthaṁ prakīrtitāḥ |brāhmas tu prathamas teṣāṁ prājāpatyas tathaiva ca ||

column3: athāṣṭau vivāhāḥ sambhavanti brāhmo daivo gāndharvva teṣāṁ pūrve saptobhayatasteṣāṁ vindetālābhe mānuṣam |
teṣāṁ pūrve iti teṣāṁ vivāhānāṁ madhye pūrve teṣāṁ vivāhānāmalābhe mānuṣaṁ vindeta labheta ||
atra yadyapyekatameneti sarvaṁ pratyaviśiṣṭaṁ tathāpi yo |
brāhmadaivārṣagāndharvāsurarākṣasān uktvā āpastambaḥ teṣāṁ traya ādyāḥ praśastāḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ śreyān ||
yo yasya dharmo varṇasya guṇadoṣau tu yasya yau |
tadvaḥ sarvaṁ pravakṣyāmi prasave ca guṇāguṇān ||

column3: paiśācaścāsuraścaiva na kartavyau kadācana iti brāhmaṇe |
brāhmaprājāpatyārṣadaivāḥ brāhmaṇasya gāndharvva ācchādya cārcayitvā ca śrutaśīlavate svayam |
āhūya dānaṁ kanyāyā brāhmo dharmmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
ācchādya vastrayugaṁ paridhāpya arcayitvā arccanāṁ devalaḥ |
brāhmeṇa tu vivāhena dadyāt kanyāṁ supūjitām ||
adbhiryā dīyate kanyā brahmadeyeti tāṁ viduḥ ||
tatra savarṇaḥ savarṇāya vidito viditāya yo nagnikāṁ sa brāhmaḥ ||
yat kanyāyā ā pradānaṁ grahaṇaṁ kriyate ||

column3: iyaṁ vyavasthā yat kanyārthaṁ mūlagrahaṇena vikraye |
patanti niraye ghore ghnanti ca ā saptamaṁ kulam |
yāsāṁ nādadate śulkaṁ jñātayo na sa vikrayaḥ |
arhaṇaṁ tu kumārīṇām ānṛśaṁsyaṁ ca kevalam ||
vivāhe yat kanyāpitre dānaṁ tat kāmyaṁ na mūlyārpaṇaṁ |
gāndharvaḥ sa tu vijñeyo maithunyaḥ kāmasambhavaḥ ||
maithunyaḥ mithunasya karmma maithunaṁ tasmai hitam |
prītihetuḥ sa gāndharvo vivāhaḥ pañcamo mataḥ ||
alaṁkṛtya alaṅkāraṁ kṛtvā yā icchantī tayā saha saṁyogo |
hatvā chittvā ca bhittvā ca krośantīṁ rudatīṁ gṛhāt |
vīryyahetur vivāhaḥ saḥ rākṣasaḥ saptamo mataḥ ||
hatvā chittvā ca śīrṣāṇi rudantīṁ rudadbhyo haret |
yasmin balena pramathya haret sa kṣātraḥ ||
